column1: # Stage S11a, agent J3b — the headless browser gates leave developer_tools. The Chrome DevTools
# Protocol client (the browser and page handles, Chromium discovery and launch, the gate font
# cache) becomes the chrome_devtools_protocol crate; the gate suites (the static server, the DOM
# oracle, the route drift check, the editor smokes, the data viewer gate, the screen capture
# harness, the doctor, the session tokens and fixture scripts) become the browser_gate_suites crate
# with the DOM oracle fixtures and the gate environment pin. The ballistics agreement and offline
# mortar suites and the `gate` and `capture` command lines stay in developer_tools until S11b and
# name the new crates. The crate roots, the client's module declarations and the command lines'
# imports are written by hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# chrome_devtools_protocol: the client; cdp.rs becomes the browser and page module, the launch
# helpers get a name saying what they hold
# browser_gate_suites: the suites, their tests, the DOM oracle fixtures and the gate environment pin
# the moved suites name the client crate and their own crate
# the suites left in developer_tools until S11b name the new crates
# the gate and capture command lines name the new crates
